title: rDPS Meter
changeNote: 0.1.39 - Support for game v0.114.0 (beta). On v0.114.0 the Blocked meter counted every point of block twice, and damage soaked by Osty and Wuppy was not counted at all, because the game now works each hit out once before applying it. Both fixed. No change on the main branch. Builds and binds against v0.111.0, v0.111.1, v0.113.0, v0.113.1 and v0.114.0.
